hooks.name: Verify AWS credentials on edit
hooks.description: After the AWS access key file is saved, run aws sts get-caller-identity and report whether the credentials are valid or expired.

action.prompt: The AWS access key file was just edited. Do NOT open, read, or echo that file. Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` in the terminal and report the result. If it succeeds, say the credentials are valid and show only the Account and Arn (never any keys or tokens). If it fails with ExpiredToken or similar, say the credentials are expired. If it fails with InvalidClientTokenId, SignatureDoesNotMatch, or similar, say they are invalid. If the aws CLI is missing or no credentials are configured, say that instead. Keep the report to a couple of lines.
